brief:
Israel assassinated Hamas's internal security chief in Gaza City in a strike that killed seven people, Al Jazeera English reported. The operation targeted the senior commander as Israeli military operations in Gaza continue.

The strike marks another significant blow to Hamas's leadership structure in the enclave. No further details on the circumstances or timing of the operation were immediately available.
dek: Israel assassinated Hamas’s internal security chief in Gaza City, killing him and six others in a strike…
title: Israel kills Hamas security chief in Gaza strike
